mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 64 degrees under overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. We have a first quarter moon out there tonight. The overnight low will drop to 57 degrees, with no rain expected before morning.
The City of Verona has recently updated its Comprehensive Plan, known as Envision Verona, which serves as a long term guide for the city's future growth and expansion.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or join the crowd for Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music performances at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at recent reports, on September 5, officers responded to a series of calls regarding the viral dairy dare trend, where cheese was found placed on windshields throughout the city.
The Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a facility remodel. They will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM to serve the community again.
